snippet.title: Longplay of Rosco McQueen: Firefighter Extreme
snippet.description:
Longplay of Rosco McQueen: Firefighter Extreme, played as the NTSC version on the PlayStation. This game's version was released on Aug. 31st, 1998. Please give the video a like! Timecodes are below:

By: Val
